newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DOCDATA INITIAL OFFERING PRICED AT DFL 25.25.
newsitem.headline: DOCDATA INITIAL OFFERING PRICED AT DFL 25.25.

text.p: DOCdata NV said on Thursday that its global offering has been priced at 25.25 guilders ($13.00) per ordinary share.

Of the 5 million ordinary shares to be sold in the offering, 3 million ordinary shares will be sold by the company, raising proceeds (excluding expenses) of 70 million guilders ($36 million). The remaining 2 million ordinary shares are being offered by current shareholders of DOCdata.
In connection with the offering, DOCdata's shares have been approved for listing on the official market of the Amsterdam Exchanges and for quotation on the Nasdaq national market.
Trading in each market is commencing today.
Payment for and delivery of the ordinary shares being sold in the offering is expected to take place om May 6, 1997.
